metadata.question: Did the Indus Basin aquifer region centered at coordinates 31.998723, 73.931617 (within a 10km radius) experience significant groundwater decline between 2003 and 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use GRACE/GRACE-FO data for groundwater storage changes - Collection: "NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON_CRI" or "NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND" - Date: 2003-2013 (split into two periods for comparison) - Location: Point at 31.998723, 73.931617 with 10km buffer 2. Masking strategy: - GRACE data doesn't need cloud masking - Focus on liquid water equivalent thickness (lwe_thickness) - Compare early period (2003-2005) vs late period (2011-2013) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check if collections have data (.size()) - Check if results are valid numbers (not None/NaN) - A negative change indicates groundwater decline (Answer A) - A positive or near-zero change indicates no significant decline (Answer B) - Significant decline threshold: >20mm decrease over the period ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([73.931617, 31.998723]); const region = point.buffer(10000); // 10km radius const earlyStart = '2003-01-01'; const earlyEnd = '2005-12-31'; const lateStart = '2011-01-01'; const lateEnd = '2013-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON_CRI') .filterDate(earlyStart, earlyEnd) .filterBounds(region) .select('lwe_thickness'); const lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON_CRI') .filterDate(lateStart, lateEnd) .filterBounds(region) .select('lwe_thickness'); const earlySize = await earlyCol.size().getInfo(); const lateSize = await lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Early period (2003-2005) images: ${earlySize}`); console.log(`Late period (2011-2013) images: ${lateSize}`); if (earlySize === 0 || lateSize === 0) { console.log("No data available for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean water thickness for each period const earlyMean = earlyCol.mean(); const lateMean = lateCol.mean(); // 4. Calculation const earlyValue = await earlyMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const lateValue = await lateMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const earlyCount = await earlyMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); console.log(`Early period mean LWE: ${earlyValue !== null ? earlyValue.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`Late period mean LWE: ${lateValue !== null ? lateValue.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${earlyCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (earlyCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (earlyValue === null || lateValue === null || isNaN(earlyValue) || isNaN(lateValue)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } const change = lateValue - earlyValue; console.log(`Change in groundwater storage: ${change.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Decline detected: ${change < -20 ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`); // Significant decline is defined as >20mm decrease if (change < -20) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
